encodes: A scheme that signs bytes whose reference was taken over a canonicalized form: it verifies a different object than the one that was signed.
description: The reference is the digest of a key-sorted rewrite, not of what was signed.
limits: This shows one canonicalization (key-sorted JSON). Other rewrites of signed bytes are not covered.
